plugins.name: bmad-companion
plugins.description: Global right-side panel BMAD-METHOD companion for any workspace: analyzes project state after each prompt result to recommend contextual /bmad-* skills with tailored prompts and recommended AI models, auto-launches next prompts in a new session, reconciles v6 YAML and v7 TOML trackers with code reality, and visualizes phase, epic, and story progress.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 全局右侧栏 BMAD-METHOD 伴侣插件：动态检测可用模型、Provider 与订阅状态并智能匹配最佳模型，一键开启新会话执行，支持双向对齐追踪文件、折叠阶段、打开制品与查看 Git Diff。

plugins.name: vibe-debrief
plugins.description: Comprehension-first right-side panel for vibe-coders: fuses 80% STE-100 clarity, always-on interactive SVG diagrams, inline proof & uncertainty checks, standalone HTML export, complex-only 3b1b animated explainers, and 1-click ZCode Memory saving.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向视觉学习者与多项目 Vibe 编程开发者的右侧栏插件：融合 STE-80 清晰表达、全回合交互式 SVG 流程图、证据与不确定性审计、独立 HTML 导出、复杂流程动画解说及一键写入 ZCode 记忆库。
